title: Why Does Your Phone Get Hot?
description: Why does your phone get hot while charging or gaming? The simple science of electricity and heat.
tags: why does my phone get hot
comment: Does your phone get hot? Which one is it? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does your phone get hot?
Whenever electricity flows through tiny wires and chips, a little energy turns into heat.
Charging, gaming and video calls make the chip and battery work harder, so more heat is made.
Hot sun, thick covers and closed pockets stop the heat from escaping.
Too much heat can make the battery age faster, so the phone slows down to protect itself.
Take off the case, keep it in shade, and avoid heavy use while fast charging.
